OUTSIDE an active transaction (autocommit over the pg driver), so SET LOCAL is discarded and current_setting('choros.tenant_id') reads ''. An RLS/audit trigger casts the empty GUC to uuid -> every seed INSERT dies with 'invalid input syntax for type uuid: ""' before any assertion runs. Even blocks with BEGIN (lines 129/156/192/225/310) put SET LOCAL on the line BEFORE BEGIN, so it is still a no-op in the new txn. Consequence: live proof of AC-2 (trigger), AC-3 (config-only), AC-4/AC-5 (atomic promote+audit), AC-6 (read-scope), and the R-2 409 path is non-functional.
